title: LongSearchEval: Evaluating Long-Horizon Web Search Capabilities of Large Language Models via a Trajectory-Aware Agent Framework with Failure-Node Localization
abstract: arXiv:2610.35150v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon web search requires LLM-based agents to integrate information across web pages through extended interactions under task-specific constraints. Evaluating this capability is important not only for measuring final answer quality, but also for assessing whether an agent acquires, verifies, and uses evidence reliably over extended interactions. Existing evaluations, however, mainly rely on simulated trajectories or on post-hoc trajectories reconstructed from final answers, rather than on retained real interaction traces, which limits the fidelity of behavioral assessment and weakens support for fine-grained error localization. To address this gap, we introduce LONGSEARCHEVAL, a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework that combines a unified agent execution protocol with source constrained outcome verification and retrospective failure-node localization. Stage 1 verifies answer groups against agent-cited webpages without human

translated_title: LongSearchEval：基于轨迹感知代理框架与失败节点定位的大语言模型长程网络搜索能力评估
translated_abstract: 长程网络搜索要求基于大语言模型的代理在任务特定约束下，通过长时多轮交互整合跨网页的信息。评估这一能力不仅对衡量最终答案质量十分重要，也对评估代理能否在长时交互中可靠地获取、验证和使用证据至关重要。然而，现有评估主要依赖模拟轨迹或从最终答案事后重构的轨迹，而非保留的真实交互记录，这限制了行为评估的真实性，并削弱了对细粒度错误定位的支持。为填补这一空白，我们提出了LONGSEARCHEVAL，一个轨迹感知的代理评估框架，它将统一的代理执行协议与基于来源约束的结果验证以及回顾性失败节点定位相结合。第一阶段在没有人工干预的情况下，针对代理所引用的网页对答案组进行验证……
tldr: 该论文提出了LongSearchEval框架，通过统一代理执行协议、来源约束的结果验证与回顾性失败节点定位，基于真实交互轨迹评估大语言模型的长程网络搜索能力，并支持细粒度的错误定位。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces LongSearchEval, a trajectory-aware agent evaluation framework that assesses LLMs' long-horizon web search capabilities using real interaction traces, combining a unified agent execution protocol with source-constrained outcome verification and retrospective failure-node localization for fine-grained error analysis.
